top_signals.title: Robinhood’s Quirk on ETFs and the Next Generation of Investors
top_signals.summary: Robinhood Markets Chief Brokerage Officer Steve Quirk joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Quirk discusses how younger investors are trading through volatile markets, Robinhood’s push toward 24/7 access and tokenization, and the firm’s evolving role in prediction markets. He also details Robinhood’s involvement in Trump Accounts and what the program could mean for a new generation of investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: U.S. Oil Drillers Pick Up the Pace Just as Oil Prices Fall
top_signals.summary: The total number of active drilling rigs for oil and gas in the United States rose this week, according to new data that Baker Hughes published on Friday, with the total rig count in the US rising to 607, up 53 from this same time last year. The number of active oil rigs rose by 6 to 469 during the latest reporting period, according to the data. This is 50 above this same time last year.
